title: Identity verification (eKYC)
intro: BuildMate uses eKYC to confirm that a contractor or material-store profile belongs to the named owner. The result supports partner review and is not an administrator approval.
itemPurpose: Verify identity before the profile is sent to an administrator.
itemValid: Use a valid, unobstructed citizen ID card.
itemCamera: Turn the camera on and allow browser access.
itemLight: Stand in good light and avoid glare on the card.
itemClear: Do not cover your face or wear a mask or sunglasses.
frontHint: Place the card in the four-corner frame. Text, number, and portrait must be sharp.
backHint: Capture the back of the card. A face photo cannot replace the back side.
frontReference: Front photo just captured, for comparison.
invalidImage: Use a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image within the size limit.
cameraDenied: Camera permission is blocked. Allow it and try again.
cameraError: The camera could not be opened.
faceAsCard: This is not an ID card photo. Please capture the document.
faceAsBack: This is not an ID card photo. Please capture the document.

card.ok: The ID card is sharp and aligned. You can capture it.
card.missing: Place the ID card in the center of the frame.
card.center: Place the ID card in the center of the frame.
card.tilt: Straighten the ID card a little.
card.tiltLeft: Straighten the ID card a little.
card.tiltRight: Straighten the ID card a little.
card.perspective: Straighten the ID card a little.
card.glare: Change the angle to avoid reflected light.
card.corners: Keep the whole ID card inside the frame.
card.blur: Hold the phone steady and refocus.
card.dark: Move to a place with enough light.
card.far: Move the ID card closer to the camera.
card.close: Move the ID card a little farther away.
card.occluded: Do not cover the information on the ID card.

ocrPreflight: The ID card could not be read. Please recapture the front.

ocrField.MISSING_NAME: The full name could not be read.
ocrField.MISSING_ID: The 12-digit ID number could not be read.
ocrField.MISSING_DOB: A valid date of birth could not be read.

faceLead: Keep your face inside the circle. A pose counts only after the server confirms liveness, not merely because five motions were attempted.
distanceHint: Keep a medium distance so the face fills the circle without being cropped.
processingWait: Keep this window open. A timeout is reported if the service does not respond.
timeout: Verification timed out. Please try again.

task.ocr: Read the ID card with OCR
task.match: Compare the face with the ID portrait

ocrIncomplete: Required ID fields are missing. Retake the card photos.
submitted: The profile was sent for administrator review.

aiStatus.AI_PASSED: AI passed — not an administrator approval
aiStatus.SUBMITTED: eKYC sent, waiting for administrator review

needSubmit: Finish eKYC and send it before leaving this step.
resumeFace: This verification session is not finished. Please repeat the face step.
unavailable: The verification service is unavailable. Please try again.

codes.MULTIPLE_FACES: Only one person can be in the frame.
codes.FACE_TOO_SMALL: The face is too small. Move closer to the camera.
codes.NOT_CENTERED: The face is not centered. Look straight at the camera.
codes.WRONG_POSE: That pose was not completed. Try it again.
codes.SPOOF: A live person was not confirmed. Do not use a print or screen.
codes.DIFFERENT_FACE: The frames are not the same person.
codes.UNKNOWN: The check could not be completed. Try again.
